dashboard.placement_title: Have you studied in the past?
dashboard.placement_desc: Take the placement test to skip the basics you already know and configure your profile.
dashboard.why_learn_little_title: Why am I learning so little at first?
dashboard.why_learn_little_desc: Our SRS algorithm intentionally limits the introduction of new concepts to a few characters per day. This prevents cognitive overload and promotes long-term retention. Once introduced, characters will reappear for review after 10 minutes. Don't worry, the pace will naturally accelerate in the coming days!
dashboard.vocab_kanji_desc: 300-500 high-frequency words + Kanji radicals. Unlocked when Hiragana and Katakana are completed.
dashboard.vocab_words_desc: High-frequency words. Unlocked when Jamo and Syllables are completed.
